method: Browser fetch() from a page on the deployed app's own origin, https://effervescent-bubblegum-1e5c03.netlify.app.
purpose: WP29 build-time check: does the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed endpoint answer cross-origin from the app origin, with what shape, and under which terms.

results.decision: used (FNG_URL); fetched directly, no same-origin rewrite needed

quotes: You must properly acknowledge the source of the data and prominently reference it accordingly.
Commercial use is allowed as long as the attribution is given right next to the display of the data.
terms.scope: The page applies these rules "to all of our fear and greed data, not just the API".
terms.prohibition: The data must not be used to impersonate Alternative.me or to make a service that could be confused with it.
terms.decision: The panel shows 'Data: Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index', linked, next to the gauge; the source is also listed in About, Data sources and thanks.

not_verified: rate limits: none is documented; the index is updated daily, and the app fetches at most once per hour while the panel is open
